commits.message: Review: the marquee crosses the slot it draws, cyclic copies and refuses a fractional turn, the scrub seeks on the left button, the depth reads writesToTerminal (rich-animation-42lg.xoj)
The animation playground is a readable example: kinds a few to a file, a draggable scrub bar, four colour depths (rich-animation-42lg.xoj)
cyclic and marquee: a rotation through a list, and content of any width crossing a slot a cell a step (rich-animation-42lg.xoj)
Review: one helper clicks the playground to 1 fps and checks it landed; the loop-jump comment says snapped loops exceed the bar (rich-animation-42lg.xkk)
Review: the playground speed test checks it reached 1 fps; the loop-jump comment says it measures the raw field, not the snapped one (rich-animation-42lg.xkk)

The loop-jump and playground speed tests do their work once, not per fill or per 60 fps frame (rich-animation-42lg.xkk)

The loop-jump check computed each frame's field once per fill, touched every
cell anew though a frame holds few distinct shares, and converted each color
to OKLCH at both its steps; it now does each once, the same values compared.
The playground's speed test reads only the readout, so it plays at 1 fps, as
the seek test beside it already does. Alone: 5.4/7.1/14.4s -> 0.3/2.1/3.6s
and 6.8s -> 0.3s; full suite at load ~28: worst 9.0s against the 30s timeout.

The e2e suite serves the site's xterm.js from disk, not jsDelivr (rich-unfiled-791c.5v4l) (#541)

* The e2e suite serves the site's xterm.js from disk, not jsDelivr (rich-unfiled-791c.5v4l)

A stalled CDN fetch left every live terminal at Run with no error, which
read as a regression in the page. e2e/test.ts routes jsDelivr for every
spec: XTERM's files come from the pinned @xterm/xterm devDependency (the
browser's integrity check holds the two to one version), anything else
there is aborted.

* The CDN route sits on every context and refuses loudly (review: rich-unfiled-791c.5v4l)

Pages a spec makes from browser were unrouted; aborted or missing-file
requests vanished; installed xterm could drift from XTERM's URL.

* A seam test holds e2e pages to routed contexts; refusals say why (review: rich-unfiled-791c.5v4l)

Specs import test only from e2e/test.ts and route their own contexts
through cdn; a refused request carries its reason; files read once per
worker; xterm.ts names both version pins. Self-hosting for visitors is
rich-unfiled-791c.abt1. Early failure on a refusal is not possible from
a route handler; teardown names the URL.

* The refusal list is read after its contexts close; the version pin is a unit test (review: rich-unfiled-791c.5v4l)

Gate reads e2e/ recursively and across lines; served() returns a tagged
union. Rejected: serving .map files and URL decoding — nothing requests
either.
